posts.text:
The firing of Scott Pelley is a warning for our democracy.

This is the same Scott Pelley who reminded us: In 1798, the Sedition Act made it illegal to criticize the government—reporters went to jail for doing their jobs.

Madison taught us that freedom of the press guarantees all the others. Attacking journalists is an assault on the truth that sustains our democracy.
